landlock_rules.kernel_note: Landlock requires Linux >= 5.13; the S10+ vendor kernel is 4.14.253, so these rules are INTENT ONLY and are not applied. nuxel-sandbox degrades gracefully (LANDLOCK_UNAVAILABLE) instead of refusing to launch.

network_policy.kernel_note: On 4.14 the per-app match is cgroup v1 net_cls classid 16973825 = 0x01030001 (nft 'meta cgroup 0x01030001'). The cgroupv2 'socket cgroupv2' matcher requires Linux >= 5.13 and is not used on this device.

enforcement.apparmor: profile configs/apparmor.d/usr.bin.nuxel-dialer; effective only if apparmor is present in /sys/kernel/security/lsm (verify with nuxel-security-audit.sh)
enforcement.note: ModemManager access is the real gate for calls/SMS; the Shannon modem has no upstream plugin, so the radio path is BLOCKED_HARDWARE.
